reason: My admin already puts our transfers into a sheet, so this saves her maybe an hour a week. That isn't worth letting a bot I've never heard of into our work group and onto my Google account.
objection: The bot sits in a chat where staff also talk about guests, owners and money, and it connects to my Google account. 'Only sees one sheet and folder' is just a line on a page. I have no idea who is behind it or where those receipt photos end up.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked without touching my Google account or the group (my admin forwards the receipts and gets back a sheet or file she uploads herself), plus a real company name and a written policy on where the documents are stored and when they get deleted.
